verdict.rationale: Pika's Camera Director app gives creators some camera-side control by re-shooting an uploaded clip from a different angle or viewpoint. Nothing documents choosing specific camera moves such as pan, zoom, orbit or static at generation time. Pikaframes only allows a prompt to guide motion between keyframes, and Motion Transfer guides subject movement rather than the camera, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: explicit pan, zoom, orbit and static camera-move controls, camera direction during text- or image-to-video generation, detailed docs on how Camera Director moves are specified, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks
